scope: GenBank Eukaryota assemblies at chromosome or complete level

mitochondrial_association.definition: Assembly report contains associated organelleInfo with a description containing 'mitochond'.

plastid_association.denominator_definition: Viridiplantae assemblies in the tracked collection.
plastid_association.definition: Assembly report contains associated organelleInfo with a description containing 'chloroplast' or 'plastid'.

sex_chromosome_labels.definition: Explicit chromosome-name labels in the NCBI genome sequence report. This includes X/Y/Z/W/U/V-style and generic sex-chromosome labels and measures assembly labelling, not the organism's inferred biological sex-determination system.

rules.XY labelled: Both X and Y labels detected, without Z/W.
rules.ZW labelled: Both Z and W labels detected, without X/Y.
rules.Other / partial label: At least one X/Y/Z/W-style or generic sex-chromosome label detected, but not a clean XY or ZW pair.
rules.No sex-chromosome label: No explicit X/Y/Z/W-style or generic sex-chromosome label detected.

source.sequence_report: NCBI Datasets genome sequence report (chrName; assembled-molecule/chromosome records)
